name: GEDAI EEG denoising (raw)
summary: Unsupervised EEG denoising of continuous data by leadfield filtering (GEDAI; Ros et al. 2025). Non-commercial licence -- see the app README.

outputs.description: The signal GEDAI removed (EEG channels only)

options.label: adaptive
options.description: AdaptiveMultibandGedai -- authors' recommended offline pipeline, highest quality, substantially slower

parameters.description: High-pass (Hz) before fitting. Empty/null disables it.
SENSAI noise weighting -- higher keeps more brain signal. A number > 0, or a preset: standard / auto (3.0), aggressive (1.5), conservative (6.0).
broadband / multiband: segment length (s) for covariance estimation.
Exclude 'bad'-annotated spans from the fit (GEDAI recommends keeping them).
multiband / adaptive: run an initial broadband GEDAI pre-pass.
adaptive only: wavelet cycles per band.
multiband / adaptive: wavelet bands below this (Hz) are zeroed. 'auto' uses the data high-pass.
Name of a flat reference channel to add before fitting (preserves rank for non-average references). Kept in the output.
Name of an MNE built-in montage to attach before fitting (e.g. standard_1005, GSN-HydroCel-257). Needed when channel names are non-standard and no positions are stored.
How GEDAI's reference covariance is built.

options.label: auto
options.description: 10-05 names -> bundled leadfield; else positioned channels -> fsaverage template forward solution (~35 s).

options.label: leadfield
options.description: Force the bundled 10-05 leadfield; drop unmatched channels.

options.label: forward
options.description: Force the fsaverage template forward solution (needs positions).

options.label: channel_positions
options.description: Fast distance-based covariance -- lower fidelity, tends to over-clean.

parameters.description: Interpolate channels marked bad before fitting.
What to write as the denoised output.

options.label: recombine
options.description: full copy of the input with the EEG replaced by the denoised signal

parameters.description: Parallel jobs; match the allocated CPUs (currently 8).
